# Test audio sources

All clips are short excerpts of [LibriVox](https://librivox.org/) recordings.
LibriVox recordings are in the **public domain** (LibriVox dedicates its
recordings to the public domain), and the texts read are public-domain works.
No recordings of real players are included.

Clips were decoded, cut and converted to 16 kHz mono 16-bit PCM WAV.

| File | Language | Time in source | Work | Reader | Source file |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `en_magi_1.wav` | English | 23.8–31.9 s | O. Henry, *The Gift of the Magi* (1905) | Betsie Bush | [gift_of_the_magi_henry_blb_64kb.mp3](https://www.archive.org/download/giftofmagi/gift_of_the_magi_henry_blb_64kb.mp3) ([LibriVox page](https://librivox.org/the-gift-of-the-magi-by-o-henry/)) |
| `en_magi_2.wav` | English | 44.9–52.8 s | same | same | same |
| `ru_belkin_1.wav` | Russian | 50.4–62.0 s | А. С. Пушкин, *Повести покойного Ивана Петровича Белкина*, «От издателя» (1831) | Xenium5 | [belkintales_00_pushkin_64kb.mp3](https://www.archive.org/download/belkintales_1406_librivox/belkintales_00_pushkin_64kb.mp3) ([LibriVox page](https://librivox.org/belkin-tales-by-alexander-pushkin/)) |
| `ru_belkin_2.wav` | Russian | 64.6–71.8 s | same | same | same |

Reference transcripts in `manifest.toml` come from the original texts.
